description: Resolve free text (area name, ONS code, postcode, street) to geography ids (uk:lsoa|msoa|borough:…) and, where recorded sales exist, address ids (uk:addr:…). Use the returned ids with get_area_metric, rank_areas_by_metric, get_address_history. It only looks names up: to shortlist where to live use find_areas, to resolve a household's places (work, a station, a school) for find_areas or get_commute use search_places. Coming soon: until Close Knit opens to assistants this tool answers status coming-soon, no data.
